Meta.title: Mordjane — Hazelnut spreads & pastry creams
Meta.description: Hazelnut and peanut creams, crunchy rocher spreads, glazing pastes and baking essentials. Cash on delivery across Tunisia.

Home.title: Hazelnut creams, smooth or crunchy
Home.subtitle: Plus peanut cream, glazing pastes and El Mordjene baking essentials. Order today, pay the courier on delivery.

login.title: Staff sign in
login.subtitle: Manage orders, stock and the catalog.

orders.title: Orders
orders.cancelText: Reserved stock will be returned to the shelf. This can't be undone.

products.title: Products
products.name: Name
products.deleteText: This permanently removes the product. Products in past orders can't be deleted — mark them unavailable instead.
products.availableHint: Unavailable products are hidden from the shop.
products.featuredHint: Shown on the home page with a “Best seller” badge.
products.imageHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.
products.saveFirst: Save the product first, then add an image.

errors.slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
errors.stock: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
errors.shelfLife: Enter a number of months, e.g. 12.
errors.duplicateWeight: Two sizes have the same weight.

products.sizesHint: Each size has its own price and stock. Changes save as you go; to change a size's weight, add a new size and switch the old one off.
products.sizesNewHint: Add every size you sell, e.g. 200 g, 600 g, 2.5 kg.
products.sizeImagesHint: Click a size's photo to add or replace it (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB); sizes without their own photo show the product photo.
products.uploadSizeImage: Add a photo for this size
products.sizeImageInherited: Shows the product photo. Click to add one for this size.
products.productInfoHint: Shown on the product page, like a data sheet.
products.arabicHint: Shown on the Arabic shop. Leave empty to show the French text there.

categories.title: Categories
categories.deleteText: Only empty categories can be deleted. Deactivate it to hide it instead.

delivery.title: Delivery areas
delivery.subtitle: The delivery fee is set per governorate. At checkout, customers pick an active governorate, then one of its active delegations.
delivery.deleteText: Its delegations are deleted with it. Governorates with past orders can't be deleted — switch them off instead.
delivery.delegationsText: Customers in this governorate pick one of its active delegations at checkout. The delivery fee stays the governorate's.
delivery.noActiveDelegations: No active delegation: customers can't choose this governorate at checkout.
delivery.deleteDelegationText: Delegations with past orders can't be deleted — switch them off instead.
delivery.delegationInUse: {name} has orders, so it can't be deleted. Switch it off to hide it at checkout.
delivery.nameArHint: Shown on the Arabic shop. Left empty, the French name is used.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Choose who receives emails and for which events.
notifications.staffHint: Sent to your team about orders and stock.
notifications.noRecipients: No recipients yet: staff emails are not sent.
notifications.thresholdHint: A size counts as low at or below this many units. The alert is sent once, when stock drops to this level.
notifications.customerHint: Sent to the email the customer gives at checkout, in the language they ordered in.
notifications.serverHint: Set by the server's SMTP settings.
notifications.localHint: Local testing: emails are caught by Mailpit. Open the <link>test inbox</link> to read them.
notifications.testHint: Leave empty to use the saved recipients.
